GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Race started cloaked in fog, misty rain and gloom. Settled Down 1 length on fence, Headed and crossed mid-race, Moved Up to trail Two Wide by a long neck turning, kept trying in Straight but no match for 1-2 in the run home. [Stewards permitted jockey to ride 1.0kg overweight.] # battled on fairly

Jumped okay & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 3.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, blocked on straightening, shouldered clear at 200m and ran on hitting Lead at the 75m, kept going to post # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 1200m, eased after gelding got its head up & shifted out towards heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd Two Wide trailing 0.75 Lengths , Moved Up and took Lead at 500m, led Two Wide by a long neck turning, kept going in Straight # just lasted to win

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 8 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 6 Lengths rail-2 Wide turning, blocked on straightening, finally got around heels at 125m, finished on to the line. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages. Stewards questioned rider re tactics adopted. Jockey explained she was instructed to settle handy with cover but, after beginning slowly, she was unable to comply, settling further back than intended. Trainer confirmed instructions.] # no luck in straight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Raced keenly in the early stages. Held up for clear running rounding the home turn until approaching the 100m. Wanted to lay in under pressure over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well and Went Forward to 1.5 Lengths Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led by a head turning, kept going in Straight battling to line despite being Headed at the 150m. (Blinkers AGAIN, Cross-over Nose Band AGAIN) [Stewards questioned app. jockey re his tactics. Comments noted.] # led/battled on okay
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned re tactics, including the tempo set in the race, Rdr explained intention to settle in a handy position and after showing superior speed, elected to take up lead, adding was comfortable with the tempo set.
Began awkwardly. Raced keenly in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped out at the start & Settled Down 2 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn then Hooked Out to 2.5 Lengths 3 Wide , held own ground and 3rd place in Straight # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Jumped out at the start and bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to Two Wide Lead by 0.75 Lengths settling down, crossed mid-race and led 1 length rail turning, Headed 160m, kept trying to line # led/battled fairly

Jumped best and Settled Down 2nd Two Wide trailing 0.75 Lengths , Drifted Back to 2 Lengths Two Wide turning, Dropped Out in straight. [Stewards permitted jockey to ride 0.5kg overweight.] # weakened badly
